bias.label: Leaning down below 3,888; holding above 3,830-3,843 support

event: FOMC minutes Wed 18 Nov at 21:00 SAST (Kitco: 2 p.m. EST).

bullets.title: Quiet into close
bullets.text: Goldprice.com had spot gold at 3,849.02 at 21:47 SAST, down 0.24% on the day, after a 3,842.80-3,887.60 range (Kitco).

bullets.title: Bounce faded
bullets.text: The early push to 3,887.60 failed, and price spent the afternoon just above the 3,843 support after the retail sales data.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: Trading Economics cites 93% odds of a December quarter-point hike from CME FedWatch; Kitco earlier cited 96.6%, so sources differ.

bullets.title: Dollar near highs
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 103.5, close to a 19-month high, and US yields are about 5.11% (tenor UNVERIFIED), still a headwind for gold.

bullets.title: Fed speakers hawkish
bullets.text: Trading Economics reports Musalem backing multiple hikes and Hammack favouring gradual hikes, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Near one-year low
bullets.text: Monday's low near 3,830 is gold's weakest in over a year, so a break there could speed up selling.

bullets.title: FOMC minutes next
bullets.text: Wednesday's FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can move gold fast if they sound more hawkish.
